La controladora es un personaje imaginad:
The flight controller is an imagined character.
The spacecraft, the dates and the facts are real.
ENERGÍA AGOTADA. Reintentando la fase co: POWER DEPLETED. Retrying the phase with a minimum reserve.
LEER EL HUD Y LA ENERGÍA: READ THE HUD AND THE POWER
Centro de seguimiento de Goldstone, Cali: Goldstone tracking station, California. 2 March 1972: Pioneer 10 lifts off, bound for Jupiter.
La Pioneer 10 se separa del cohete Atlas: Pioneer 10 separates from its Atlas-Centaur rocket. From now on it travels alone.
Arriba a la izquierda está el AÑO. Este: Top left is the YEAR. This journey will last decades.
Arriba a la derecha, el OBJETIVO de cada: Top right, the OBJECTIVE of each phase.
Abajo, la ENERGÍA del RTG, la batería nu: Below, the POWER from the RTG, the spacecraft's nuclear battery. It drops over time and with every phase, and it cannot be recharged.
Diseñada para 21 meses.\nNadie sabe toda:
Designed for 21 months.
No one knows yet how long it will last.
La Pioneer 10 entra al cinturón de aster: Pioneer 10 is entering the asteroid belt. We can't correct its course in real time: we'll guide it with last-second maneuvers. Help it avoid every one.
Muévete en cualquier dirección (WASD o f: Move in any direction (WASD or arrows) and dodge the asteroids
ESCUDO AGOTADO: PIERDES TIEMPO DE VUELO: SHIELD DEPLETED: YOU LOSE FLIGHT TIME AND POWER
Primera nave en atravesar el cinturón de: First spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt.
Lo logramos. Había menos asteroides de l: We made it. There were fewer asteroids than expected.
La radiación de Júpiter daña los instrum: Jupiter's radiation damages the instruments. We have to decide what to photograph before the camera fails.
Mueve el visor (WASD / flechas), pulsa E: Move the reticle (WASD / arrows), press ENTER or click to scan and keep the moon inside the circle
Calisto es una de las lunas con más crát: Callisto is one of the most heavily cratered moons in the solar system: its surface is very old.
Ganímedes es la luna más grande del sist: Ganymede is the largest moon in the solar system: it is bigger than the planet Mercury.
Bajo la corteza helada de Europa podría: Beneath Europa's icy crust there may be an ocean of liquid water.
Primera nave en fotografiar Ganímedes de: First spacecraft to photograph Ganymede up close.
Tenemos las tres lunas antes de que la r: We got all three moons before the radiation beat the camera.
La radiación venció a la cámara, pero gu: The radiation beat the camera, but we saved the photos we managed to take.
A/D o ←/→: girar la antena · mantén el h: A/D or ←/→: turn the antenna · keep the beam on Earth
El Sol acaba de lanzar una tormenta: una: The Sun has just unleashed a storm: a huge cloud of particles is traveling through space toward Pioneer 10.
No es la única que la ve. La Pioneer 9,: It's not the only one watching. Pioneer 9, much closer to the Sun, records it too. Two spacecraft measure the same storm from different places.
¡La tormenta llega a la nave y la sacude: The storm reaches the spacecraft and shakes it! Keep its antenna pointed at Earth or we'll lose the signal.
Pasó lo peor. La antena sigue mirando a: The worst is over. The antenna is still looking home and the storm data reached Goldstone.
Perdimos parte de la señal, pero la ante: We lost part of the signal, but the antenna is looking home again. The storm data is still coming in.
Noviembre de 1973. La Pioneer 10 cruza e: November 1973. Pioneer 10 crosses the edge of Jupiter's magnetosphere: the enormous magnetic bubble that surrounds the planet.
Al entrar, la temperatura del gas que la: As it enters, the temperature of the surrounding gas rises about a hundredfold. Its instruments record everything, for the first time in history.
La nave superó el susto, aunque la energ: The spacecraft got through the scare, although its power dropped a little.
Pasan los años. La Pioneer 10 sigue alej: The years go by. Pioneer 10 keeps moving away and its power falls. We keep sending commands.
Enero de 2003. Llega la última señal de: January 2003. Pioneer 10's last signal arrives. It took 11 hours and 20 minutes to cross space to reach us.

Last calculated position:
about 80 times the distance between Earth and the Sun.
Esta es la placa de la Pioneer 10: un ho: This is Pioneer 10's plaque: a man, a woman, the solar system and our position relative to 14 pulsars.
Las líneas de la placa miden la distanci: The lines on the plaque measure the distance from the Sun to each pulsar. Find the point where all those distances agree.
Para medir cada distancia, sincroniza el: To measure each distance, sync up with three pulsars: tap to the rhythm of their flash and a circle will appear around them.
Sincroniza 3 púlsares y ubica el Sol don: Sync 3 pulsars and place the Sun where their circles cross
1) Haz clic en un púlsar (o flechas y EN: 1) Click a pulsar (or arrows and ENTER) and tap to the rhythm of its flash
2) Ubica el Sol donde se cruzan los círc: 2) Place the Sun where the circles cross (click, or arrows and ENTER)
Pulsa ENTER o clic cuando el anillo lleg: Press ENTER or click when the ring reaches the pulsar
El Sol está donde se cruzan los círculos: The Sun is where the circles cross
Lo logramos. Quien lea esta placa sabrá: We did it. Whoever reads this plaque will know where the spacecraft came from.
Si alguien la encuentra, sabrá de dónde: If anyone finds it, they will know where we came from.
Del cinturón de asteroides a Júpiter y m: From the asteroid belt to Jupiter and beyond
Sonda Pioneer 10, con su placa y su bate: Pioneer 10 probe, with its plaque and its nuclear battery (RTG)
Una controladora de vuelo imaginada, con: An imagined flight controller, with real facts
Acompañar a la Pioneer 10 desde Goldston: Accompany Pioneer 10 from Goldstone through every phase, as its power runs out, until you decode the message on its plaque.
Fíjate en el año, el objetivo y la energ: Watch the year, the objective and the power: you'll use them in every phase.
Muévete en cualquier dirección. Los aste: Move in any direction. Asteroids with a trail are faster, and each impact uses up one shield segment.
La foto necesita al menos 70 % de precis: The photo needs at least 70% accuracy. The reticle lags, and you can't scan during a radiation spike: wait for it to pass.
Mira la cinemática. Cuando llegue la tor: Watch the cinematic. When the storm arrives, turn the antenna so the beam stays on Earth.
Observa cómo baja la energía y se debili: Watch the power drop and the signal weaken.
Haz clic en un púlsar y pulsa al ritmo d: Click a pulsar and tap to the rhythm of its flash: 3 circles are enough. The Sun is where they cross.
This is the end of the journey.
